findings.description: Undocumented arguments return `None` as their description instead of an empty string. Return `self.help or ""` to preserve the formatter's expected string value.
findings.rationale: When a command has both a documented argument and an argument with `help=None`, the documented argument enables the positional-arguments section. The undocumented argument now supplies `(metavar, None)` to `formatter.write_dl`, replacing the previous `(metavar, "")` fallback. The formatter expects strings, so rendering `--help` raises a TypeError instead of displaying help.
